# Nexus Aurora (M) Sdn Bhd

> Managed IT services provider (MSP) based in Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia, serving businesses across Sabah and Malaysia. ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified. Powered by Pioneer Infotech Singapore, with 17 years of APAC managed-services experience.

- Office: Lot 3 Block C 1st Floor, Lorong Bunga Inai, Taman Land Breeze, 88200 Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, Malaysia
- Phone / WhatsApp: +60 12 885 9759
- Email: sales@nexus-aurora.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00 (MYT)
- Service area: Kota Kinabalu, Sabah, and Malaysia

## Services

- [Managed IT Services (MSP)](https://nexus-aurora.com/managed-services): 24/7 monitoring, proactive maintenance, helpdesk support, backup and disaster recovery, and infrastructure management for Malaysian businesses, with a 99.9% uptime SLA.
- [Cybersecurity](https://nexus-aurora.com/cybersecurity): security audits, penetration testing, compliance (ISO 27001, PCI-DSS and others) and incident response, from an ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified team.
- [Cloud Hosting](https://nexus-aurora.com/cloud-hosting): web hosting, VPS and dedicated servers, business email hosting, free SSL and daily backups.
- [System & Server Management](https://nexus-aurora.com/system-servers): server consolidation, VMware and Hyper-V virtualization, Microsoft server solutions and backups.
- [Structured Cabling](https://nexus-aurora.com/structured-cabling): Cat6/Cat6A and fiber optic installation, server rack cabling, and cable testing and certification to TIA/EIA standards.
- [IT Consultancy](https://nexus-aurora.com/it-consultancy): IT planning for hotels and businesses in Sabah, covering infrastructure design, cabling, PABX, IPTV, wireless networks, vendor selection and project oversight.
- [Web Development](https://nexus-aurora.com/web-development): custom websites and web applications built with React, Next.js and TypeScript.
- [Mobile App Development](https://nexus-aurora.com/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android apps using native, React Native and Flutter.

## Products

- [NexusBot](https://nexus-aurora.com/nexusbot): WhatsApp AI assistant for Malaysian SMEs that answers, qualifies and books customers in English, Bahasa Malaysia or Chinese. Plans from a free 7-day trial to Enterprise.
